description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IWebAudioPlayerIpc class, which provides IPC APIs for web audio playback in the Rialto client. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and documentation comments.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IWebAudioPlayerIpc instances.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerIpc
classes.description: Interface defining IPC methods for web audio playback.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Creates a new IWebAudioPlayerIpc object with specified client, mime type, priority, and config.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available frames and shared memory info for audio data.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the delay in frames of the playback.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer of audio frames for playback.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred/max frames and support for deferred play.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current audio volume level.
